name: com.midmanstudio.nuclear
description: Nuclide chart, binding energies, decay chains, fission, neutron capture and fusion for games. A dependency-free Rust core (nuclear_core, AME2020, NUBASE2020 and ENDF/B-VIII.0 data) behind a C interface, with plain C# bindings that need no Unity engine references. Standalone and game-agnostic.
